post.description:
Adds multiple items to the registry in an atomic transaction.

**Response:**
*   **`201 Created`** - Returns the list of created items and count.

Adds a new item to the registry.

**Response:**
*   **`201 Created`** - Returns the newly created `RegistryItem` object.
    ```json
    {
      "id": "clxfa5z...",
      "name": "Stand Mixer",
      "description": "A powerful stand mixer for all our baking adventures.",
      "category": "Kitchen",
      "price": 299.99,
      "image": "/images/mixer.jpg",
      "vendorUrl": "https://example.com/mixer",
      "quantity": 1,
      "isGroupGift": false,
      "purchased": false,
      "purchaserName": null,
      "amountContributed": 0,
      "contributors": []
    }
    ```

Scrapes metadata in parallel for batches of up to 20 product URLs with a concurrency limit of 5.
Individual URL failures do not abort the overall batch.
The entire batch operation times out after 15 seconds.
